body:
## Problem and behavior

PXD018722 native intracellular measurements can now be queried, but the source
package does not define a defensible training target. Add the registered
`pxd018722_native_contrast_v1` recipe: one control-to-PSMD2-knockdown change in
within-parent log10 peptide/reference signal per nonreference peptide.

The fixed cohort requires literal human nonengineered origins at one complete
parent sequence, agreeing resolved declared parents, valid search/confidence
support, and six positive original sequence-level signals. Hashes choose the
reference and split the complete source dependency components before selection.
All excluded decisions, six source ratios, twelve measurement contributions,
modification/matching annotations and component/parent weights remain auditable.
Zeros do not become negatives, numbered acquisitions do not become paired
specimens, and raw signals do not become molar concentrations.

The public materialize/verify interface pins source/recipe contracts, preserves
independent snapshots and replays every typed output. A failed support gate is
reported without changing eligibility or partitions. Version: 2.0.38.

## Validation and interpretation

- `./format.sh`, `./lint.sh`, 36 focused tests and all 3,547 current-main default tests pass (the original base passed 3,544).
- Tests cover original quantity grain, precursor/load/fixed-peptide-response
  cancellation, no pseudoreplication, ambiguous/unresolved/reporter origins,
  zero/missing signals, all-source dependencies, unequal group weights, hash-only
  reference/splits, no overwrite and refreshed-hash target-tamper detection.
- Independent real-source replay verifies all 10,647 dispositions, 228 targets
  and 2,736 measurement contributions. The frozen cohort has 82 parents across
  81 components: training 55 components/158 contrasts, validation 8/38, test 18/32.
- Public materialization/replay: 29.36 seconds, 2,483.3 MiB observed process-tree
  RSS. Independent original-value replay: 4.04 seconds, 1,866.1 MiB. All resource
  limits pass. An initial local test memory-preflight refusal is preserved; the
  unchanged guard admitted the later passing run after capacity recovered.

This qualifies a conditional native-signal response dataset for a prospective
screen. No predictor is fitted here. The validation partition is at its minimum
component support; APC transfer, concentration calibration and the latent full
peptide distribution remain unresolved.

Follow-up to #837 and merged source PR #839. Keep #837 open for the broader data
and biological-validation work. The recipe must pass hosted checks and its tested
PyPI release before use in the separately registered biological fit.


[Registered Presto source-admission report and exact reproduction bundle](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/84b1e593bf8ffd8effc642ea32b93422e13b9a99/experiments/2026-10-25_0612_codex_native-contrast-admission/README.md). The current-main amendment preserves the original successful run and verifies the same package under rebased commit 90a7a62 in 5.06 s / 1,702.9 MiB, with no cohort or target changes. Source release 40168710669 tests current main d2e0cb6 after concurrent PR840; original successful e755be4 artifacts are verified and retained, not uploaded over the newer same-version main.
